title: Unreleased photo of massive triangle over water

tellings.quote: they're they're there the one is a massive triangle above the water I mean this thing is huge

plain: There is said to be an unreleased photograph of a huge triangle-shaped object hanging above water. Bob Maguire, a former contractor for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, says he has seen it and tells Michels "this thing is huge." He does not say where the water was or who took the picture, but if the photo exists it would be striking evidence of a very large craft.
